issues.title: [WSG-01] Kit/session integration tests do not exercise fragmented raw reads
issues.reportedProblemExcerpt: `FakeConnectionPair` / `FakeRawConnection` is a **datagram** wire: it is built on `Channel<ByteArray>`, so exactly one `write(bytes)` becomes exactly one `emit(bytes)` on the partner's read flow. The shipped TCP transport is a **stream** wire: `JvmRawConnection.read()` emits `buffer.copyOfRange(0, n)` for whatever `n` bytes the kernel happened to have, so a large write arrives as many arbitrary chunks and small writes coalesce. Every test that runs above the raw-connection boundary in `commonTest` therefore runs on a wire that can never fragment, never coalesce, and never short-write.

issues.title: [WSE-07] Post-start Android permission loss is reported as a platform failure
issues.reportedProblemExcerpt: The audit's title asserts a TOCTOU because "runtime permission is never checked before use." Verified: that premise is **inverted**. `checkSelfPermission` followed by a call *is itself* the TOCTOU — permission can be revoked between the check and the call — so catching `SecurityException` at the call is the race-free approach, and the module does exactly that and maps it to a typed `PermissionMissingForProvisioning`. Moreover, the pre-flight check the audit wants already exists as a public API (`AndroidP2pPermissionManager`) and is documented as the *host's* job.

issues.title: [WSB-16] prepareFinish() error text says FILE_DONE on the authenticated FILE_FINISH path
issues.reportedProblemExcerpt: `StreamingFileReceiver.prepareFinish()` throws a `P2pError.ProtocolError` whose hardcoded text names the frame `FILE_DONE`.
